blocks.text: Motorists will see a mixed adjustment in fuel prices starting on Oct. 6, with gasoline again going up even as diesel slightly dips. In separate advisories, Shell Pilipinas and Seaoil said the prices of their gasoline products per liter would increase by P1.90 and P1.93, respectively.
